Title: Public preview: Azure Load Testing support for user specified JMeter properties

Body.Content:
With user properties, you can make your test configurable by keeping test settings outside of the JMeter test script. 

Use cases for user properties include:

  • Using the JMX test script in multiple deployment environments with different application endpoints.
  • When your test script needs to accommodate multiple load patterns such as smoke tests, peak load, or soak tests.
  • When you want to override default JMeter behavior by configuring JMeter settings, such as the results file format.

Azure Load Testing supports the standard Apache JMeter properties and enables you to upload a user properties file. You can configure one user properties file per load test.

Learn more about Azure Load Testing Preview support for JMeter user properties.
